  • Method Details

    • confirmTotp

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/api/account/totp/confirm", produces={"application/json","application/problem+json"}, consumes="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<RecoveryCodesResponse> confirmTotp(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid ConfirmTotpRequest confirmTotpRequest)
      POST /api/account/totp/confirm : Confirms the enrolment of the authenticator app Checks a code produced by the authenticator app against the pending secret, enables the factor and generates a fresh set of recovery codes, shown only in this answer.
      Parameters:
      confirmTotpRequest - (required)
      Returns:
      The authenticator app is enabled (status code 200) or Invalid request, no enrolment in progress or wrong code (status code 400) or Missing or invalid bearer token (status code 401) or The authenticator app is already enabled (status code 409)

    • disableTotp

      @RequestMapping(method=DELETE, value="/api/account/totp", produces="application/problem+json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> disableTotp()
      DELETE /api/account/totp : Disables the authenticator app Removes the authenticator app and the recovery codes of the authenticated account and revokes every trusted device of the account. Disabling a factor that is not enabled succeeds as well. While the account has a confirmed second factor, the bearer token must show a recent multi-factor sign-in (step-up, RFC 9470).
      Returns:
      The authenticator app is disabled (status code 204) or Missing or invalid bearer token (an RFC 6750 challenge and no body), or the account has a confirmed second factor and the token does not show a multi-factor sign-in (acr urn:irurueta:acr:mfa) whose auth_time is within authserver.mfa.step-up-max-age (default 5 minutes). The latter is answered as RFC 9470 describes, with WWW-Authenticate Bearer error=\"insufficient_user_authentication\", acr_values=\"urn:irurueta:acr:mfa\", max_age=\"300\" (the configured age in seconds) and a problem body; the client signs the user in again with those acr_values and max_age and retries with the new token. (status code 401)

    • enrollTotp

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/api/account/totp", produces={"application/json","application/problem+json"}) org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<TotpEnrollmentResponse> enrollTotp()
      POST /api/account/totp : Starts the enrolment of an authenticator app Generates a new shared secret for the authenticated account and answers the otpauth URI and its QR code. The enrolment is pending until it is confirmed with a code; starting it again replaces a pending secret. Requires a bearer token issued by this server.
      Returns:
      Enrolment started (status code 200) or Missing or invalid bearer token (status code 401) or An authenticator app is already enabled for the account (status code 409)
